venue.name: Saanichton Christmas Tree Farm
venue.description: Saanichton Christmas Tree Farm is a family run 5 acre farm on East Saanich Road, growing up to 15 varieties of B.C. Christmas trees for u-cut and pre-cut sale, plus fresh produce, flowers, squash and preserves. For the Christmas season the fields open for cutting your own tree, with hand saws and twine supplied and free hot apple cider, and a decorated Santa's Workshop building sells wreaths, swags and greenery. A self serve produce stand is open spring through fall. The site publishes no school programs, group rates, booking process or field trip information of any kind, so anything a class or daycare needs would have to be arranged directly with the farm.
venue.address: 8231 East Saanich Road, Saanichton, BC, V8M 1T5
restrictions: Dogs are welcome but must be on a leash at all times. We ask that you please pick up after your pet
This year in our fields, no tree under 6 feet in height can be cut
venue.hours_notes: November 15th to 30th: 9am to 4pm daily. December 1st to 23rd: 9am to 7pm daily. The u-cut fields close at 4pm every day because they are not lit. Closed Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
venue.seasonal_notes: The season dates published on the site are for 2025: open from November 15 to December 23. The farm also has a self serve produce stand open spring through fall, and Santa's Workshop opens for the Christmas season.

programs.name: U-cut Christmas tree visit
programs.description: The farm's fields open for the Christmas season so visitors can walk out and cut their own tree, alongside pre-cut trees, wreaths, swags, garland and greenery sold from Santa's Workshop. Hand saws and twine are supplied and there is free hot apple cider. Trees are priced per foot, between $8 and $15 a foot in the 2025 season, and no tree under 6 feet may be cut in the fields. The farm publishes nothing about school or group visits, so there is no group rate, no capacity and no booking route on the site.
programs.what_children_do: Walk out across acres of planted trees to pick one, then watch it come down with a hand saw from the farm and be carried back and tied to the car. Signs through the farm name the different kinds of tree, and there is free hot apple cider.
programs.our_note: The fields shut at 4pm because they are not lit, even on the days the shop stays open until 7, so an afternoon group has a narrow window. Dress everyone for wet ground and cold. There is no published price or arrangement for a class, so phone the farm before you plan anything with a group.
programs.practical_summary: This is an outdoor working farm and the site says nothing about washrooms, indoor shelter or anywhere a group could sit and eat. The season is short, roughly mid November to just before Christmas, so ring well ahead.
programs.extra_fees_note: There is no published admission charge. Trees are priced per foot, between $8 and $15 a foot in 2025, and pre-cut trees are priced individually by species, size and quality. They take cash, debit, Visa, Mastercard and American Express.
programs.evidence: Our trees range in size from 2 to 12 feet in height and are priced per foot, in 2025, between $8-15/foot.

images.alt: A wooden barn with a Santa's Workshop sign on the gable, hung with wreaths and red bows, with snow on the ground and small trees outside.
A large cut tree tied across the roof of a yellow car on a wet driveway lined with tall evergreens.
